This is a Windows-only release. The latest macOS release remains unchanged.

- Supports native x64 and ARM64 builds.
- Improves overlay alignment, transparency, and edge rendering.
- Keeps the overlay visually attached to the Codex window while it moves or resizes.
- Restores the overlay immediately after startup, color selection, and Codex activation.
- Refreshes the tray icon and improves app-server discovery and cleanup.
